When the national debt passes $39 trillion and a political class treats borrowed money as free, America has forgotten what its most-forgotten Founder knew in his bones: freedom isn’t free. Robert Morris financed the Revolution, bet the largest fortune in America on a country that didn’t yet exist, and then paid his debts in prison instead of asking for a handout. While Morris once staked everything on America’s future, today we’re mortgaging our future to pay for our present.
